evidence.quote: Failure to properly maintain buildings, facilities and equipment used in the manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API).
Your firm has no documentation to show that these out of specification test results were investigated nor did you perform any product impact assessment.
Your firm failed to conduct an annual product quality review of your API.

affected_work.value: API 제조 시설·설비 유지관리, 엔도톡신 및 시험결과의 조사와 평가, 품질 부서의 문서·CAPA·시험결과 검토, API 연례 제품품질 검토, 생산 및 QC 실험실에서 사용되는 물질의 시험과 시료 채취 위치 기록이 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: During our walk-through of the manufacturing facility on March 2 and 3, 2026, we noted there were areas of the building that had excessive corrosion, water leaking from equipment, and deterioration of walls and floors.
